reactions.quote: Sharp, tender and quietly devastating. I finished it in a single sitting and immediately wanted to start again.
Wickedly funny about the things we never say out loud. It made me laugh, then made me think about my own 'not now, dear' moments.
Elegant, mischievous, and full of heart. The kind of book you press into a friend's hands.
